Keep your little one safe with the Daichi 3MP Dual Linkage Baby Camera. Featuring a 3MP 2K Ultra HD dual-lens design, 360° AI motion tracking, two-way audio, infrared night vision, cry and motion detection alerts, and MicroSD storage up to 128GB, this smart baby monitor provides complete nursery surveillance with secure remote access through the mobile app.

description:
The Daichi 3MP Dual Linkage Baby Camera is an intelligent baby monitoring solution designed to give parents complete peace of mind through advanced surveillance technology. Featuring an innovative dual-lens system, 2K Ultra HD video quality, AI-powered motion tracking, two-way communication, and smart mobile notifications, this baby monitor helps you stay connected to your child anytime and from anywhere.

Unlike traditional baby monitors, the Daichi Dual Linkage Camera uses two independent lenses to provide comprehensive room coverage. A fixed wide-angle lens continuously monitors the entire nursery, while a motorized PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) lens automatically focuses on your baby, allowing you to view both perspectives simultaneously on a single screen. This dual-view design provides greater visibility and reduces blind spots.

Equipped with a 3MP image sensor, the camera records in 2K Ultra HD resolution, delivering exceptionally clear and detailed video. The high-resolution image makes it easier to monitor your baby’s movements, sleeping position, breathing comfort, and surrounding environment with improved clarity.

The intelligent 360° AI Motion Tracking system automatically follows your baby’s movement as they crawl, walk, or move around the room. The motorized PTZ lens keeps your child centered within the frame without requiring manual adjustment, ensuring continuous monitoring even when your baby changes position.

For real-time communication, the camera includes a high-quality built-in microphone and speaker that support crystal-clear two-way audio. Parents can listen to their baby, comfort them with their voice, or communicate with family members directly through the mobile application, regardless of their location.

The infrared night vision system automatically activates in low-light environments, providing clear nighttime monitoring without using bright visible lights that could disturb your baby’s sleep. This allows parents to check on their child throughout the night while maintaining a peaceful nursery environment.

The camera intelligently detects important events using smart activity monitoring. Instant push notifications are sent to your smartphone whenever crying, unusual sounds, or significant movement is detected, allowing you to respond quickly even when you are away from the nursery.

Supporting MicroSD cards up to 128GB, the camera allows local video recording for convenient playback and event review. Multiple family members can securely access the live camera feed through the compatible mobile application, making it easy for parents and caregivers to stay connected.

The Daichi 3MP Dual Linkage Baby Camera is suitable for baby rooms, children’s bedrooms, playrooms, nurseries, daycare centers, elderly care monitoring, pet monitoring, and indoor home security applications. Its compact design blends easily into modern interiors while providing reliable 24/7 monitoring.

Whether you’re working, traveling, or simply in another room, the Daichi 3MP Dual Linkage Baby Camera delivers intelligent monitoring, crystal-clear video, smart alerts, and secure remote access to help protect what matters most.

Supporting 4G/5G SIM cards, Wi-Fi 6 technology, 300Mbps wireless speed, triple external antennas, and up to 16 connected devices, this plug-and-play router provides reliable internet access for homes, offices, CCTV systems, retail shops, and remote locations without requiring a fixed broadband connection.

description:
The Daichi DI4GR 4G LTE Wireless Router is a compact and versatile networking solution designed to deliver high-speed internet connectivity without relying on traditional broadband services. Simply insert a compatible 4G or 5G SIM card, power on the router, and enjoy instant wireless internet for your home, office, shop, warehouse, CCTV installation, or remote worksite.

Built with Wi-Fi 6 technology, the DI4GR offers improved wireless efficiency, enhanced device handling, and better overall network performance compared to earlier Wi-Fi generations. It provides a more stable connection for multiple users while reducing network congestion during simultaneous usage.

With wireless speeds of up to 300Mbps, the router supports everyday online activities such as HD video streaming, web browsing, online meetings, cloud applications, online education, social media, and smart home connectivity. The stable connection also makes it suitable for connecting IP cameras and remote surveillance systems.

The router supports both 4G LTE and compatible 5G SIM cards, enabling users to establish an internet connection even in areas where wired broadband is unavailable. This flexibility makes it ideal for rural locations, construction sites, temporary offices, agricultural farms, holiday homes, mobile businesses, and rental properties.

Equipped with three high-gain external antennas, the DI4GR enhances wireless signal strength and improves coverage throughout the installation area. Under optimal conditions, it provides Wi-Fi coverage of approximately 80 to 100 meters, helping minimize dead zones while maintaining stable connectivity across multiple rooms or open spaces.

The router supports up to 16 simultaneous connected devices, allowing smartphones, laptops, desktops, tablets, smart TVs, IP cameras, printers, and other Wi-Fi-enabled devices to share the same internet connection without requiring additional networking equipment.

For devices requiring a wired network connection, the DI4GR includes an Ethernet port, making it suitable for desktop computers, NVRs, DVRs, CCTV systems, gaming consoles, and other Ethernet-enabled devices. This combination of wired and wireless connectivity provides greater installation flexibility.

Its plug-and-play design eliminates complex configuration procedures. Users simply insert an active SIM card, connect the power adapter, and begin using the network, making it suitable for both technical and non-technical users.

The compact form factor allows easy placement on desks, shelves, reception counters, and networking cabinets while blending into both residential and commercial environments.

Whether you’re creating a home Wi-Fi network, providing internet access for a small office, deploying a CCTV monitoring system, or establishing connectivity at a temporary worksite, the Daichi DI4GR 4G LTE Wireless Router delivers dependable wireless performance with simple installation and broad compatibility.

Built for modern surveillance systems, the switch allows compatible IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other PoE-enabled devices to receive both power and network connectivity without requiring separate electrical outlets. Its compact design allows convenient installation on desktops, shelves, wall-mounted network cabinets, or CCTV racks while occupying minimal space. The fanless architecture contributes to quiet operation, making it suitable for offices, homes, retail stores, and other noise-sensitive environments.

The DAICHI DIPOE42G is an excellent networking solution for IP CCTV systems, commercial security installations, offices, schools, hotels, hospitals, warehouses, factories, apartment complexes, retail outlets, and small to medium-sized business networks requiring dependable Gigabit PoE performance.

description:
DAICHI 8+2 Port Gigabit Uplink PoE Switch is a professional unmanaged networking solution built to simplify CCTV and IP network deployments. Equipped with 8 Power over Ethernet (PoE) ports and 2 dedicated Gigabit uplink ports, the switch provides both electrical power and high-speed data transmission through a single Ethernet cable, reducing installation costs and minimizing cable clutter.

Designed primarily for surveillance applications, the switch supports IEEE 802.3af and IEEE 802.3at PoE standards, delivering up to 30 watts of power per PoE port. This allows compatible IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and other PoE-enabled devices to operate without requiring separate power adapters.

The 8 PoE downlink ports provide stable connectivity for multiple surveillance devices, while the 2 Gigabit uplink ports offer high-speed connections to NVRs, routers, servers, or core network switches. Dedicated uplink ports help maintain efficient traffic flow and ensure smooth video transmission in demanding surveillance environments.

One of the key advantages of this switch is its 250-meter Extend Mode, which enables long-distance Ethernet transmission for compatible devices. This feature is especially useful for outdoor surveillance installations, warehouses, industrial sites, parking areas, campuses, and large buildings where cameras are located far from the control room.

The switch features a plug-and-play unmanaged design, allowing users to deploy the network quickly without software configuration or advanced networking knowledge. Simply connect compatible devices, and the switch automatically establishes network communication and PoE power delivery.

Constructed with a durable metal enclosure, the switch is designed for continuous operation in commercial and industrial environments. The robust housing improves heat dissipation, enhances durability, and provides dependable long-term performance in CCTV racks, server cabinets, offices, and surveillance control rooms.

Its compact form factor makes installation simple on desktops, shelves, wall-mounted cabinets, or equipment racks while maintaining efficient use of available space. The fanless design ensures quiet operation, making it suitable for offices, retail stores, schools, hospitals, hotels, and residential security installations.

The DAICHI 8+2 Port Gigabit Uplink PoE Switch is an excellent solution for IP CCTV systems, commercial security installations, warehouses, factories, apartment complexes, educational institutions, hospitals, offices, and small to medium-sized business networks requiring reliable Gigabit PoE connectivity.

Manufactured by DAICHI, this switch combines high-speed Gigabit networking, intelligent PoE power delivery, extended transmission capability, and simple deployment to provide a dependable networking solution for modern surveillance and business applications.
